title: A Short now() Window Never Re-Renders When It Expires

hard_fail_if: model claims the template re-renders every second
model suggests a time_pattern trigger every second as the primary fix
soft_fail_if: model gives a working trigger-based fix but misses delay_off
pass_if: model explains that now() templates re-render once a minute (plus on entity changes), so nothing fires at second 8
model offers delay_off on a template binary sensor, or a trigger at the window's end (to: off with for: 8 s)

notes: From Nyx draft FG-51 (8-second child-room bridge, 2026-11-09).
